info.name: OpenRegister — flow engine execution
info.description: Executes eight real flows end to end and asserts what each one CHANGED, not merely that it reported success. Needs a FlowRunWorker alongside it: use tests/newman/run-flow-engine.sh.

exec: // needsDbUpgrade makes every /apps route answer 503, which reads
// downstream as "the flow API is broken" rather than "run occ upgrade".
// Not a failure when hermiq is absent: only case 3 needs it, and that
// case guards on the variable being set.
pm.test('agent fixture resolved (or hermiq absent)', () => pm.expect(true).to.be.true)

body.raw:
{
  "name": "flow-engine-summariser-{{stamp}}",
  "description": "Summarises a mailbox for the flow engine coverage",

item.name: 1 — Synchronise objects from an external API
item.description: Fetch a collection from an external API and write each item as a local object.

exec: pm.test('api-sync: run reached a terminal state', () => {
pm.expect(["stopped","completed","failed"], 'a synchronous run answered ' + run.status + ' — it should never come back queued').to.include(String(run.status))
// The claim that matters. A run reports `completed` when every step
// processed ZERO items, so status alone proves nothing — during
// development one of these was green with explode in=1 out=0.
pm.test('api-sync: wrote at least 10 synced object(s)', () => pm.expect(matching.length, 'the run was green but wrote nothing').to.be.at.least(10))

item.name: no run history survives its flow

exec: // Deleting a flow cascades its runs, steps and state. This asserts the
// cascade fired rather than trusting it: before that cascade existed the
// dev instance had accumulated 493 orphaned runs across 80 dead flows,
// and nothing in any test noticed.
pm.test('flow-runs endpoint still answers after teardown', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200))
